field.label: Require sign-in for web access
field.help: Devices on the networks below can only use websites after they have signed in on the login page. Everything else (DNS, DHCP, mail, other services) keeps working.

field.label: Networks that must sign in
field.help: Choose the LAN or VLAN interfaces whose devices have to sign in. The interface needs a static IPv4 address.

field.label: Check passwords with
field.help: The name of an authentication server from System > Access > Servers. "Local Database" uses the users you created under System > Access > Users.

field.label: Only these groups may sign in
field.help: Optional. Leave empty to let every user of the server sign in. Enter group names as they exist on the server.

field.label: Stay signed in for (hours)
field.help: After this time the device has to sign in again.

field.label: Sign out after being idle (minutes)
field.help: 0 turns this off. A device is idle when it has no traffic for this long.

field.label: Never ask these devices
field.help: Addresses or networks that do not have to sign in: servers, printers, your own admin computer.

field.label: Login page message
field.help: A short text shown under the title, for example who to ask for an account.

field.label: Login page port
field.help: The login page is served over HTTPS on the firewall address of each network at this port.
